Terms of Use

Effective date: 3 October 2026

These terms are between you and xDev, not Apple. Apple is not responsible for the app or its content, and has no obligation to provide maintenance or support for it. If you have a question or a claim about the app, contact xDev, not Apple.

Price and MindMap AI Pro

The app is free. MindMap AI Pro is an optional one-time in-app purchase that unlocks extra features, described in the app and on the MindMap AI page.

Apple handles the purchase. The price is shown in the App Store before you buy, and Apple takes the payment. Refunds are requested from Apple under Apple’s policies. Pro is available through Family Sharing. If you reinstall the app or use another device with the same Apple Account, use Restore Purchases in the app’s settings to unlock Pro again.

Your content

Your maps and everything you put in them belong to you. We claim no rights to them. They are stored on your devices and, if you use iCloud sync, in your own iCloud account. xDev does not receive them. Keep your own copies of important maps; the app can export them and make backups.

AI features use Apple’s on-device model (Apple Intelligence). AI output can be wrong, incomplete or out of date. Review it before you rely on it or share it. You decide what to accept, and you are responsible for how you use the result.

Use the app only in lawful ways. Do not use it to break the law or to violate the rights of others, and do not try to get around its in-app purchase or security protections.
